notes: IEEE 1516.1-2025 public-API scenario: two known candidates publish an owner's attribute; the second requests and cancels acquisition, leaving its cancellation confirmation queued. The owner unconditionally divests. During the first candidate's Request Attribute Ownership Assumption callback, the second federate services its cancellation confirmation. The first callback returns without acquisition, and the unowned search continues to exactly one tagged assumption callback for the second candidate. The immediate-model path uses standard Disable/Enable Callbacks services to hold that confirmation until the same callback boundary. Direct pinned mappings follow the native plan row: page-148-l61-18 and page-148-l70-21 -> Clause 7, and page-154-l156-49 -> §7.2. The adapter supplies the provider, endpoint, FOM, names, callback model, and logical-time implementation. Current-source installed-package C++ primary/contract passed 4/4 under evoked/immediate callbacks. Java parity compiles against the official API-only JAR but has no provider-runtime evidence. This is not a conformance claim.
